title: ProjectE IPC calculator report envelope
description: Shared output shape for the IPC CALCULATORS (trace_width, clearance, via_current). A calculator answers a question and has no PASS/FAIL verdict, so it exits 0 on success and 2 on bad input; it never exits 1. The pcb-tool-v2 originals emitted a bare result dict with no schema_version, no model labelling and no machine-readable limits, so a consumer could not tell a screening estimate from a sign-off number.

standard.description: Which standard (and which adaptation of it) produced this number.

model_class.description: e.g. exploratory_closed_form, tabulated_secondary_source. Mirrors common.si_models.MODEL_CLASS where the closed form is shared.

signoff.description: Pinned false. No calculator in this bundle is a sign-off tool; if that ever changes it must be a deliberate schema revision, not a silent field flip.

inputs.description: Every argument that affected the result, echoed back so a report is reproducible without the original command line.

results.description: The computed values. Shape is tool-specific.

limits.description: The honesty notes. REQUIRED and non-empty on purpose: in the archive these lived only in module docstrings, where a machine consumer could never see them, which is how a screening estimate quietly becomes a compliance claim.
